item.title: PIONEERING RESEARCH STUDY TO IMPROVE CARE OF HEARTBURN AND TACKLE CANCER GOES LIVE IN WIRRAL
item.description: Heartburn Health, a national research programme to find ways to improve care for people with heartburn, indigestion or acid reflux has launched in the Wirral and is looking for volunteers with these symptoms, aged 55-79 to take part. Supported by the NHS and Cancer Research UK, Heartburn Health is creating a community of at least 120,000 people who experience heartburn, indigestion or acid reflux. item.title: Tranmere Rovers 2-7 Runcorn Linnets | Match Report
item.description: Full-time: Tranmere Rovers 2-7 Runcorn Linnets, Liverpool Senior Cup Quarter-Final Runcorn Linnets were awarded a penalty on the half-hour mark. Naim Arsan placed it into the bottom-left corner despite Charlie Jones diving the right way. The visitors added to their lead two minutes later, with former Tranmere Rovers player Elliot Rokka finishing from close range. Rovers won a penalty themselves in the 37th minute.
